checks: The prime-to-p local period-index theorem applies to the complete excellent normal local fraction field itself, without algebraizability or a finite-etaIe splitting-cover assumption. Generic Brauer injection preserves M and gives actual scalar-weight-one rank M on the original coefficient gerbe.

At a completed strict local node all unit symbols are nth powers, so the class is c(u,v)_n. On v=uw its exceptional residue is w^(plus-or-minus c), of exact order h. Both new secondary residues retain order h; old component residues do not change.

The mixed-root orders are old mi and new h, not the old common period on every new divisor. If h=1 the new divisor has no root inertia. This avoids the old commuting (M,M) universal-generator obstruction.

The existing actual mixed-root gerbe extension retains the full mu_n coefficient class. A generic rank-M object extends coherently using the existing qualitative generator and becomes locally free after reflexive hull on regular two-dimensional etale charts. This construction is only over k, never a relative flat-hull assertion.
Connected order-m residue-character torsors force uniform generic inertia multiplicities d/m. Vector-bundle multiplicities remain locally constant on the component.

At a new (m,h) node with commutator order h, the normalized twisted group algebra has X^m=Y^h=1 and XY=zeta YX. Its m/h simple modules have dimension h, restrict to disjoint h-element X-character orbits, and are uniquely determined by those orbits. Thus rank M forces all simples with multiplicity M/m.

A rank-r object has the same inertia type as A^(r/M), including all new nodes, single-root points and points without root inertia. Local equivariant lifting and Nakayama give actual local isomorphisms. Tame invariants remain exact over arbitrary coefficient algebras, so this fixed-anchor Morita equivalence and the locally free subcategories commute with coefficient base change.

The ordinary coarse End is locally free of rank M^2 by the scalar-zero abelian-root character/monomial calculation. Coarse Hom is locally free over that order with module rank r/M; no variable order saturation is used.
Exactly e centres add e components and yield 2e nodes, so existing O(t) model budgets remain degree-linear under the established cycle pullback theorem.
No cohomology, generation, syzygy, uniform-pole or polynomial-atlas estimate is inferred for qEnd A or qHom(A,F). They are not silently identified with canonical full pullbacks.
